pages.title: Give Thanks at the Table
pages.child_instruction: Color the family gathering at the table to give thanks before the meal.
pages.bible_connection: Pausing at the table is a picture of giving thanks in everything, as 1 Thessalonians 5:18 teaches.
pages.visual_prompt: Integrated black line-art coloring scene: family table with simple autumn meal, empty chair being pulled in, clasped hands before eating, bread basket, window with falling leaves. Not a copy of Mission 3's harvest wagon. No letters in the artwork.

pages.title: Find the Table Gifts
pages.child_instruction: Find and circle all 8 table gifts. Each one can help you remember to give thanks.
pages.bible_connection: Setting the table carefully is practice for giving thanks in every part of the day.
pages.visual_prompt: Controlled dining-room background without the eight targets. Independently placed plate, cup, napkin, chair, bread basket, candle, place card, and serving spoon.

pages.title: Set the Thankful Table
pages.child_instruction: Start at the kitchen. Follow the path to the thank-you chair.
pages.bible_connection: Carrying the dish to the table is a picture of getting ready to give thanks in everything.
pages.visual_prompt: One home-interior scene: kitchen counter at START, unique hallway-and-rug maze, thank-you chair at the set table at FINISH. Not a maze pasted on a blank page.

pages.title: Give Thanks in Everything
pages.child_instruction: Check when you can give thanks. Then draw your table.
pages.bible_connection: These moments help a child practice 1 Thessalonians 5:18: give thanks in everything.
pages.visual_prompt: One table-framed page: four illustrated choices, a large table drawing area, and a short prayer ribbon.
pages.prayer: Jesus, help me give thanks in every part of my day.
